children: Strategy announced it will keep the Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch preferred dividend at 12.00% and declared cash dividends on multiple preferred series payable Sept 30 and Oct 15, 2026.
Maintains STRC regular dividend rate at 12.00% per annum effective for semi-monthly periods from Sept 16, 2026; rate published on company website.
Board declared cash dividends payable Sept 30, 2026 (and Oct 15, 2026 for STRC) to holders of STRF, STRC, STRE, STRK and STRD.
Declared per-share amounts: STRF $2.50, STRC $0.50 (semi-monthly), STRE €2.50, STRK $2.00, STRD $2.50.
Company expects these distributions to be characterized as non-taxable returns of capital to the extent of a shareholder’s tax basis for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
